title: Eriphyle
summary: Raleigh names Eriphyle in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Eriphyle (Eryphile), wife of Amphiaraus, who for a bracelet caused him to go against Thebes. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XIII, §. VIII, sig. 272a–272b
